name: The God Valley incident
text: On God Valley, the Rocks Pirates came for the World Nobles' hunt, and {role.roger.name} and {role.garp.name} fought side by side to stop them. {role.xebec.name} fell, and the Rocks Pirates were finished.
news: Strange silence from the West Blue: an island has vanished from the charts, and the Rocks Pirates are spoken of in the past tense.
divergeText: The Rocks Pirates left God Valley as they had come, and the World Nobles' hunt became something nobody would speak of.
divergeNews: Rumours from the West Blue: the Rocks Pirates have humbled the World Government at a place called God Valley.

name: Garp, Hero of the Marines
text: {role.garp.name} was hailed across every Marine base as the Hero of the Marines, and turned down the admiral's coat that came with it.
news: Marine Headquarters honours Vice Admiral Garp as the Hero of the Marines. He is said to have refused promotion again.

name: Totto Land is founded
text: {role.linlin.name} claimed a cluster of islands in the New World, made them sweet, and called the country Totto Land.
news: Big Mom has a country of her own now. Its taxes are paid in sweets, and its citizens include every race she can find.

name: The Battle of Edd War
text: In a storm off a New World island, the fleets of {role.shiki.name} and {role.roger.name} met. A storm sank half the Golden Lion's ships, and Roger's crew did the rest.
news: The Golden Lion's fleet is broken: Roger's pirates beat Shiki at Edd War, with a storm on their side.
divergeNews: Shiki's great fleet sails on unbroken. Captains in the New World are learning to dip their flags to the Golden Lion.

name: Roger reaches Laugh Tale
text: {role.roger.name}'s crew sailed past the end of every chart and landed on the last island of the Grand Line. What they found there made {role.roger.name} laugh until he cried.
news: Is it true? Sailors swear Gol D. Roger has sailed the whole Grand Line. They are calling him the King of the Pirates.
divergeNews: Gol D. Roger's crew turned back from the end of the Grand Line, the sailors say, empty-handed or keeping very quiet.

name: The Roger Pirates disband
text: {role.roger.name} gathered his crew one last time and sent them home. Few of them knew why, and {role.rayleigh.name} kept it to himself.
news: The Roger Pirates have broken up. Nobody knows where the King of the Pirates has gone.

name: The execution of Gol D. Roger
text: In the square at {place}, the King of the Pirates climbed the scaffold. Asked where his treasure was, {role.roger.name} told the whole world to go and find it, and the blades fell. The Great Pirate Era began that afternoon.
news: GOL D. ROGER EXECUTED AT LOGUETOWN. His last words: his treasure is out there for anyone who wants it. Every harbour in the world is buying ships.
divergeText: The scaffold in {place} stood empty: the King of the Pirates was never executed.
divergeNews: The Pirate King has slipped the Government's grasp. Nobody knows where he is, and the Marines are not saying.

choices.label: Watch in silence
choices.text: You watched with the crowd, and you never forgot his grin.

choices.label: Cheer the Pirate King
choices.text: Your shout was one of thousands, and the Marines noted none of them.

choices.label: Storm the scaffold
choices.text: You went over the barricade with half the crowd behind you, and the blades never fell.

name: The Golden Lion escapes Impel Down
text: {role.shiki.name} cut off his own legs to slip his chains and walked out of Impel Down on swords. He was the first ever to escape.
news: IMPEL DOWN BREACHED. Shiki the Golden Lion has escaped the Government's great prison, the first man ever to do so.
divergeNews: The Golden Lion remains a prisoner of Impel Down. The Government lets the papers say so as often as possible.

name: The Buster Call on Ohara
text: The World Government called down a Buster Call on {place} for the crime of reading history. The great library burned with its scholars, {role.clover.name} and {role.olvia.name} among them. One child, {role.robin.name}, was let go.
news: Ohara wiped from the map by a Buster Call. The Government says its scholars were reviving an ancient weapon. A bounty of 79 million Berries is posted on an eight-year-old girl.
divergeNews: Warships were seen off Ohara, then seen leaving. The scholars are still reading.

outcomes.cause: killed in the Buster Call on Ohara
killed in the Buster Call on Ohara

choices.label: Run for the boats
choices.text: You ran with everyone who could, and looked back only once.

choices.label: Save what books you can
choices.text: You carried armfuls of books into the lake and watched the tree burn above them.

choices.label: Stand against the warships
choices.text: You stood on the shore and made the warships pay for every yard, and the Buster Call broke off.

name: Portgas D. Rouge dies
text: After twenty months, {role.rouge.name} gave birth to a son on {place} and named him Ace with her last breath.

name: The fall of the Kozuki
text: In the Flower Capital, {role.oden.name} was boiled alive on {role.orochi.name}'s order, holding his retainers up above the oil for an hour. {role.kaido.name} shot him before the hour was out, and the Kozuki castle burned.
news: Wano, closed to the world, is said to have a new shogun and a new master. Ships that come near its waterfalls do not come back.
divergeNews: Strange word from Wano: the Kozuki family still holds the Flower Capital, and the pirates who came to take it have gone.

outcomes.cause: boiled alive in the Flower Capital
